column1: # How each registration or tax number is built (curated 2026-11-10 from the number survey,
# designs/company-generator-numbers.tsv, which has the structure, the check, worked examples and the
# sources of every row; labels, safe methods and sources are taken from there, not repeated here;
# rewritten 2026-11-11 for Milestone 5 with the code lists filled and the parameters made exact).
# short: the label printed with the number. serve: "no" leaves a scheme out (its rule is from one
# source only), "yes" serves one the survey left optional after Milestone 5 confirmed it, empty: as
# builder: generic (pattern + check), serial (a number up to the highest issued), or a builder
# named after the scheme, for numbers that encode the company (its form, region, year or name).
# display: how the number is printed, # or @ standing for its characters in turn (generic and serial
# numbers; empty: as the builder writes it). pattern: # a digit, @ a capital letter, [..] a class,
# {n} or {m,n} a repeat, other characters literal; the check characters come last and are not in it.
# check: none, unpublished (drawn at random), luhn, gtin, mod11_10 (ISO 7064 MOD 11,10), mod97_10
# (ISO 7064), a named algorithm, or weights:W...:RULE, where s = sum of digit x weight from the left,
# r = s mod 11 and RULE is 11-r, r, r%10, (11-r)%10, 10-s%10 or (10-s%10)%10, with exceptions "a=b"
# (a result a written b; "redraw": no number has it, draw another). groups: the legal-form groups
# holding the number (S sole proprietorship, P partnership, L limited liability, O other).
# params: name=value;...; a value "K:V,K:V" maps the company's legal form (its ISO code or key), else
# its group letter, else "*", to V; "a|b" are alternatives drawn evenly; "-" means the company holds
# no such number; "lo-hi" is a range of numbers drawn evenly; a value naming a list (cn-county,
# de-court, ...) draws from codes.tsv; anchors= names a series of anchors.tsv. A serial number grows
# with the founding year from start (number 1) to the reference date (the highest) as
# ((year - start) / (ref - start))^power; firms older than start share its first years.
